integrity: The mathematical proof is accompanied by a standalone exhaustive finite-field checker; finite checks do not establish the asymptotic. Publication or independent audit of this claim has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labelled GL_n(F_q) structure matrices, fixed q and n to infinity; the finite-n exact formula is a moment only. Diagonal F_q-rational automorphisms only, not full monomial group, automorphism group schemes or uniform isomorphism classes. Older root-of-unity and graph-group criteria are explicitly credited. Exact same statement might exist in unindexed literature.
title: Sharp scarcity and exact diagonal stabilizer moments for random perfect evolution algebras
